steps.why: The mark is for the movement: pressure on the keel pushes the enclosed stamens out, which is why the mechanism has this name.
common_mistakes: Saying the petals open like a flap. They are pressed down, and the stamens come out of the tip.
Forgetting that the stigma comes out with the anthers.
steps.memory_tip: The keel is a closed tube and the stamens are pushed out of its tip, the way a piston moves in a cylinder. That movement gives the mechanism its name.
steps.margin_note: Three lines. Name the keel petals and say what is pushed out.

steps.why: The question says "name the type", so the exact term is the mark.
common_mistakes: Writing "valvular mechanism" or "explosive mechanism". Those are other legume mechanisms, not the one named here.
steps.memory_tip: Keel closed, stamens inside, insect presses, stamens out. That movement is the piston.
steps.margin_note: The name alone is the second mark. Box it.
